intro: A curated list of presentation slides on Japanese natural language processing (NLP).
Conference tutorials, university lectures, technical deep dives by OSS developers, and industry case studies, organized by topic.
strings.wip_note: This list is still a work in progress. More material will be added over time.
strings.plugin_intro: A plugin is available to search all {total} decks in this list from Claude Code.
strings.plugin_usage: Once installed, pass a keyword or a natural language question to the `search` skill and you get up to 10 results ranked by relevance, plus a suggested reading order.
plugin_tip: You can search in Japanese, English or Chinese. The output language follows the language of your query.
Ask in natural language, e.g. "I want to read these in order starting from the basics", and you also get a suggested reading order.
strings.license_note: CC0 applies to this list itself. The copyright of each linked deck belongs to its respective presenter.
strings.titles_note: Deck titles are kept as published, so most of them are in Japanese.

入門・全体像.blurb: Where to start if you want an overview of NLP itself.

学会チュートリアル.blurb: Tutorial talks from ANLP, JSAI, and other academic conferences.

大学講義・体系的な講義資料.blurb: University courses and lecture series, including those used in book reading groups.

日本語の基礎解析（形態素解析・構文解析）.blurb: Analyzers and dictionaries that handle preprocessing specific to Japanese.

日本語テキストの正規化・表記ゆれ.blurb: Practical know-how for taming width, variant characters, addresses, and other Japanese spelling variation.

単語・文の分散表現.blurb: Word vectors, sentence embeddings, and the properties of embedding spaces.

事前学習モデル・Transformer.blurb: Pretrained models from BERT onward, and how Transformers work.

大規模言語モデル（概論・動向）.blurb: Surveys and invited talks that map out the LLM landscape.

日本語LLMの開発（事前学習・コーパス構築）.blurb: Lessons from the teams that actually built Japanese LLMs.

ファインチューニング・事後学習.blurb: Techniques for adapting an existing model to your target task.

LLM の推論最適化・サービング.blurb: Quantization, distillation, and serving infrastructure for running trained models faster and cheaper.

評価・ベンチマーク.blurb: How to measure Japanese LLM and NLP systems.

全文検索・検索基盤.blurb: Search engines and Japanese analyzers, query understanding, and ranking improvements in production.

検索・RAG.blurb: Designing, improving, and evaluating retrieval-augmented generation.

LLM アプリケーション開発・運用.blurb: Shipping LLMs inside real products and keeping them running.

テキスト分類・感情分析.blurb: Sorting documents and comments into labels, and putting classifiers to work on tasks such as content moderation.

情報抽出・固有表現・アノテーション.blurb: Extracting structured information from text, and the training data behind it.

文書処理・OCR.blurb: Turning real-world documents — invoices, contracts, business cards — into data.

質問応答・知識.blurb: Knowledge-aware language models and question answering systems.

機械翻訳.blurb: Translation model research and shipping translation services.

マルチモーダル・Vision-and-Language.blurb: Research on models that connect images and language, and VLMs built into real products.

音声認識・音声処理.blurb: Turning speech into text, and the speech processing and speech foundation models underneath it.

対話システム・音声対話.blurb: Spoken and text dialogue systems, and voice bots in production.

生成・要約・校正.blurb: Text generation and its downstream tasks.

解釈性・分析・言語学的視点.blurb: Looking inside models and evaluating them from a linguistic angle.

産業応用・実務事例.blurb: Case studies of NLP and LLMs embedded in real services and workflows.
